newsitem.title: USA: Light earthquake shakes central California.
newsitem.headline: Light earthquake shakes central California.

text.p: A light earthquake shook central California early on Saturday, waking up some local residents with a jolt, but causing no injuries or damage.

The quake, measuring 4.4 on the Richter scale, struck at 3:32 A.M. PST/6:32 A.M. EST (1132 GMT) and was centered close to Hollister, 90 miles (145 km) southeast of San Francisco, John Minsch, a geophysicist with the U.S. Geological Survey in Golden, Colorado, said.
The quake was felt through a wide area south of San Francisco.
Several local residents who called in to a San Francisco radio station said they had been woken up by the quake, which they described as a slow rolling motion lasting about a minute.
There were no reports of injuries or damage.
